assets.note: Bellek kıtlığının 2028'e kadar sürmesini bekliyor.
Aynı bellek tezinin parçası.
Uzun vadeli pozitif.

items.title: $238 possibility for SKHY
items.summary: He wrote he sees a good setup in $SKHY and that $238 is quite possible over the long term.

assets.note: Uzun vadede 238 dolar ihtimali.

items.title: Bitcoin ended its downtrend
items.summary: He wrote Bitcoin moved above its last lower high and technically ended the downtrend running since October 2025.

assets.note: Düşüş trendini teknik olarak bitirdi, ikinci boğa bayrağı hazır.

items.title: First week of October to be the low
items.summary: He said his view that the first week of October would be the low is unchanged, and although the index did not show it, stocks saw a correction.

holdings.name: SoFi Technologies

mentions.quote: If this $SOFI setup breaks down I am going to dump it

holdings.why: According to Dr J Rould, SoFi gets dumped if the setup breaks down, but he stays patient for now; no concrete trigger yet.
holdings.opinion: About a fifth of the portfolio sits in one stock; the main risk is this concentration along with yields at their highest since 2002. Credit quality and the rate path are what to watch.
ai_points: At about 21% it is the largest position, so single-stock risk is high.
High long-term yields can weigh on fintech valuations.
Dr J Rould says he will sell if the setup breaks, a technical warning sign.
There is no new information today that requires selling.

holdings.name: Meta Platforms A

mentions.quote: Zuckerberg sold $1-2M of shares, it doesn't matter much
META is developing products that directly attack AAPL's core business, we believe.

holdings.why: According to Ali Korkmaz, Zuckerberg's small share sale does not matter; Needham says Meta is developing products that attack Apple's core business.
holdings.opinion: Rivals see Meta's AI and hardware moves as a strategic threat, which is positive; but the return on AI spending is still the main question mark.
ai_points: Needham viewing Meta as a threat to Apple shows its strategic strength.
It is uncertain whether AI investment turns into durable revenue.
The founder sale is small and not a signal on its own.

holdings.name: Broadcom

mentions.quote: A big growth opportunity for $AVGO. But as much as the size of the deal, it matters whether this spending turns into sustainable revenue.
$AVGO agreed to provide up to $42B in financing for Anthropic's AI infrastructure expansion.
Broadcom $AVGO has agreed to provide Anthropic with up to $42B in financing tied to its AI infrastructure buildout.

holdings.why: According to Izzy, the $42B Anthropic financing is a big opportunity but carries customer credit risk.
holdings.opinion: Anthropic becoming the largest compute customer in 2027 gives demand visibility; on the other hand the supplier-financier role creates conflict-of-interest risk on pricing and access.
ai_points: A large customer locking in capacity for years improves demand visibility.
Financing the customer adds credit and conflict-of-interest risk.
According to Izzy, the real question is whether the spending turns into sustainable revenue.
At 13.8% of the portfolio, the concentration is reasonable.

holdings.name: BWX Technologies
holdings.opinion: Nuclear and defense demand continues, and the US Senate blocking a cap on data-center electricity prices is a supportive backdrop for the energy-demand story; the main risk is order timing.
ai_points: Demand for nuclear energy is supported by AI data centers.
The timing of the company's orders and contracts can be lumpy.
There is no data directly on this stock in today's sources.

holdings.name: Reddit A
holdings.opinion: As an ad-driven stock, growth and traffic data plus Google search arrangements are decisive; a 9.6% weight on its own adds to volatility.
ai_points: High growth expectations lead to volatile share moves.
AI changes in search raise traffic-source risk.
There is no information on this stock in today's sources.

holdings.name: iShares USD Treasury Bond 20+yr EUR Hedged (Dist)

mentions.quote: I think that when oil prices start falling, it could bring a decline in the rising long-term bond yields in developed countries and relieve markets
A possible easing in bonds will bring another leg up.

holdings.why: According to Tunç Şatıroğlu, long-term yields can fall if oil drops; that condition has not materialized yet.
holdings.opinion: Yields are the highest since 2002; for this fund that means both price pressure and strong upside if yields fall later. Long-duration risk is high.
ai_points: Fund price is under pressure as the US 10-year yield rises to 5.33%.
If yields fall, 20+ year bonds could deliver strong gains.
Tunç Şatıroğlu's scenario depends on oil falling and is not certain yet.
At 7.8% it acts as a hedge in the portfolio.

holdings.name: Amundi MSCI Turkey (Acc)

mentions.quote: I will make my next addition if it drops below 215 USD, otherwise I keep holding my current positions.
As I expected, the SME loan growth limit, part of commercial credit, has been loosened through macroprudential non-measures so that commercial credit growth rises even more.

holdings.why: According to Serkan Uelker, he adds if the BIST 100 falls below 215 in dollar terms, otherwise he holds current positions.
holdings.opinion: Loosening the credit growth cap could raise inflation and currency risk; the fund is USD-based but exposed to TRY assets, so central bank policy and the fund-crisis news flow are decisive.
ai_points: Steps that boost credit growth raise inflation and TRY risk (according to Tunç Şatıroğlu).
Serkan Uelker plans to buy below 215 in dollar terms, so he does not see the current level as cheap.
The fund crisis creates a confidence risk in Turkish markets.

holdings.name: FORGENT POWER SOLUTIONS INC.
holdings.opinion: The electrical equipment side benefits from data-center investment; the US Senate blocking the electricity price cap supports the demand story, but there is single-stock risk at a small weight.
ai_points: Data-center electricity demand provides a strong backdrop.
As a recently listed company its volatility can be high.
There is no direct information on this stock in today's sources.
